crosswalks.historical_boundary: Medieval Awaji province; current EU5 location tag awaji is used as the explicit high-coverage crosswalk.
crosswalks.resolution_method: Use the explicit current EU5 awaji location tag. The 0.95 declaration preserves residual historical cadastral uncertainty; no population or floor rescaling is applied.

area_comparison.area_method: Current calibrated EU5 location geometry with CHGIS historical-province correspondence.
area_comparison.area_difference_policy: Residual cadastral uncertainty remains explicit; do not inflate the lower bound.

crosswalks.notes: Awaji is now mappable; it remains grouped with the Farris source family and is one-sided only.

crosswalks.resolution_method: Placeholder selector intentionally yields no EU5 rows. Do not substitute Echizen or another province.

area_comparison.area_method: No distinct EU5 historical Wakasa polygon supplied.
area_comparison.area_difference_policy: No quantitative target is generated until mapping is resolved.

crosswalks.notes: The Farris value remains a documentary validation floor only.
